meta.subtitle: Beginner → Expert Masterclass Roadmap
meta.completionMessage: Congratulations! You have completed the masterclass roadmap for Android Packaging, AABs, Binary XML, resources.arsc, APK signing schemes, and the Package Manager installation pipeline!

details.title: Build & Packaging Pipeline Sequence
items: Java / Kotlin Source Code → Java Bytecode Compilation → D8 Bytecode Compiler → DEX Bytecode Generation → AAPT2 Resource Compilation → Resource Table & Binary XML Bundling → APK / AAB Packaging → APK Signing → Zip Alignment → Device Installation (PMS) → AOT/JIT Optimization (dexopt) → Application Execution

details.title: APK Signature Schemes
items: v1 Signature (JAR Signing — File-based verification via META-INF)
v2 Signature (APK Signing Block — Whole-file Merkle tree hashing, API 24+)
v3 Signature (Key Rotation support — Proof-of-rotation struct, API 28+)
v4 Signature (Streaming / IncFS — External .idsig file for cloud/fast streaming, API 30+)
Signing blocks placement before Central Directory
